note: DEPRECATED submodule (lifecycle: deprecated in its .info.yml), superseded by the CKEditor 5 plugins in media_directories_browser. Real surface: depends on media_directories_ui, contrib embed (>=8.x-1.6) and entity_embed; ships embed.button.media_directories (label Media, entity_type media, entity_browser media_directories_editor_browser, display plugin entity_reference:media_directories_image_dimensions), entity_browser.browser.media_directories_editor_browser and media_directories_editor.settings whose single nested key is embed_dialog.image_styles (EMPTY means 'show all styles'); no settings route of its own — an 'Editor Settings' details element is injected into the parent module's form by hook_form_media_directories_config_form_alter(), which also prepends media_directories_editor_config_form_submit() to $form['#submit']; hook_form_entity_embed_dialog_alter() only fires for the media_directories button and adds a linked media_library thumbnail plus a target_bundles entity-browser validator; hook_preprocess_entity_embed_container() strips data-entity-embed-display-settings; and one field formatter media_directories_image_dimensions extends MediaThumbnailFormatter. hook_install() adds the image and remote_video bundles plus view_mode:media.full; hook_uninstall() deletes the browser and button. media_directories_browser_update_11004() migrates embed_dialog.image_styles into media_directories_browser.settings:embed_image_styles. All medium/hard cases read and write that real config.

evals.prompt: What is the status of the media_directories_editor submodule in Media Directories 3.0.x, which contrib modules does it require, and what replaces it on Drupal 11?
evals.expected_output: media_directories_editor.info.yml declares `lifecycle: deprecated` with a lifecycle_link to the project page. It is the legacy entity_embed / CKEditor 4-era integration and depends on media_directories_ui, contrib embed (>=8.x-1.6) and entity_embed. On Drupal 11 its role is taken by media_directories_browser's CKEditor 5 plugins (media_directories_browser_media_directories_browser, …_image_options, …_media_file_link).

evals.prompt: Which configuration key controls the image styles offered in the media_directories_editor embed dialog, what does an empty value mean there, and how does that behaviour change after migrating to media_directories_browser?
evals.expected_output: The key is media_directories_editor.settings:embed_dialog.image_styles (a sequence of image style ids). Its form description says that if nothing is selected, ALL image styles are shown. media_directories_browser_update_11004() migrates the selected values into media_directories_browser.settings:embed_image_styles — but the new key deliberately has NO 'show all' fallback, so an empty embed_image_styles list means no image-style options are offered at all.

evals.prompt: What configuration entities does the media_directories_editor submodule install on a Drupal site, and which field formatter does its embed button use by default?
evals.expected_output: config/install ships embed.button.media_directories (label 'Media', type_id entity, entity_type media, entity_browser media_directories_editor_browser, display_plugins ['entity_reference:media_directories_image_dimensions'], entity_browser_settings.display_review false, folder SVG icon), entity_browser.browser.media_directories_editor_browser, and media_directories_editor.settings. hook_install() additionally adds the image and remote_video bundles when they exist and appends view_mode:media.full. The default display plugin uses the module's own field formatter media_directories_image_dimensions (MediaDirectoriesImageDimensionsFormatter extends MediaThumbnailFormatter), which renders the media thumbnail at explicit width/height.

evals.prompt: The deprecated media_directories_editor submodule is configured on this Drupal site with a curated list of image styles for its embed dialog. Inspect the live configuration and list exactly which image styles are offered there.
evals.expected_output: Three styles are configured: thumbnail, medium and wide. They live in media_directories_editor.settings → embed_dialog.image_styles (drush cget media_directories_editor.settings). Because the list is non-empty, only those three are offered — an empty list would mean all image styles are shown.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the embed button that the media_directories_editor submodule installs. Which media bundles can it currently insert, and which entity browser does it open?
evals.expected_output: The config entity embed.button.media_directories currently has type_settings.bundles: ['image'] — only Image media can be inserted — and type_settings.entity_browser: 'media_directories_editor_browser' (entity_type: media, display_plugins including entity_reference:media_directories_image_dimensions and view_mode:media.full). Read it with `drush cget embed.button.media_directories`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the deprecated media_directories_editor submodule so that its embed dialog offers exactly two image styles — Large and Medium — and no others. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set media_directories_editor.settings:embed_dialog.image_styles to exactly ['large', 'medium'] — either through the 'Editor Settings' → 'Embed dialog' multi-select injected into /admin/config/media/media_directories, or with \Drupal::configFactory()->getEditable('media_directories_editor.settings')->set('embed_dialog.image_styles', ['large','medium'])->save(). Leaving it empty would mean all styles are shown, which is not what was asked.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has the deprecated media_directories_editor submodule installed, and its CKEditor embed button currently allows no media bundles at all. Restrict — and thereby enable — that button so editors can insert exactly Image and Document media, leaving the rest of the button's wiring (entity type and entity browser) untouched. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set type_settings.bundles on the config entity embed.button.media_directories to ['image', 'document'], keeping type_settings.entity_type = 'media' and type_settings.entity_browser = 'media_directories_editor_browser'. hook_form_entity_embed_dialog_alter() turns that bundle list into the entity browser's target_bundles validator, so it is what actually constrains selection.
